arguments.value: This agreement gives Diplomat the right to use Kathy Ireland’s name, likeness, and endorsement to market and sell Kathy Ireland Eyewear products worldwide for a set term. In return, Diplomat must pay royalties and minimum guaranteed royalties, provide sales reports, and follow quality, labeling, distribution, insurance, and trademark rules. Kathy Ireland is expected to endorse the line, make limited personal appearances, and participate in photo and video sessions, with Diplomat covering agreed expenses. The agreement is exclusive for certain eyewear and accessories, but Kathy Ireland keeps ownership of her name and goodwill. It includes termination rights for nonpayment, bankruptcy, failure to launch or keep selling products, quality problems, breach of obligations, or damaging conduct by other endorsers. After the license ends, Diplomat must stop using her name and can only sell remaining inventory for a limited time if allowed. An addendum later required Diplomat to comply with labor and safety laws and reasonable requests from Kathy Ireland, Inc. on those issues.
